verdict.rationale: Apple's Mac help guide documents a built-in automation tool, "Automate tasks with Shortcuts," which is exactly what the story asks for. Community hands-on reports add that built-in command-line tools such as pbcopy/pbpaste can be chained in shell pipelines for routine tasks. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of Shortcuts (actions, triggers, running recurring or repetitive workflows), coverage of other built-in scripting tools, and independent hands-on corroboration of Shortcuts itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can automate repetitive tasks using a built-in automation/scripting tool

citations.quote: `pbpaste | json_pp | pbcopy` cleans up minified JSON in the clipboard
